followUp.description: At 16px, volume-low and generic volume share identical native geometry for all corner presets. This is acceptable for a generic audio/volume action; it does not provide distinct low/high level states.
followUp.recommendation: Record the native-size duplicate as intentional. Do not add arbitrary strokes or shrink the speaker to manufacture a difference. If a future UI needs low/high state distinction at16px, author an explicit volume-high optical master with two clearly separated waves and validate it as a family.
